## ⚙️ QUICK SETUP (One-Time)
1. Open **`⚙️ Master Config (Edit Here)`** and paste:
   - `N8N_API_KEY` *(n8n Settings → n8n API)*
   - `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` & `ADMIN_CHAT_ID`
   - `GEMINI_API_KEY` *(Free at aistudio.google.com)*
   - `GITHUB_TOKEN` *(GitHub Fine-Grained PAT)*
2. Select your Telegram Bot credential in **`Telegram Trigger`**.
3. Toggle this workflow **Active (Published)** and send `/menu` or `/schedule` to your Telegram bot!

## 📱 LANE 1: Telegram Controller + Schedule Advisor + Smart Queue
- Live workflow list (`GET /api/v1/workflows`) with Execute, Publish, Pause, Stop & Shift Time
- **Overlap Protection:** If a workflow is running, new runs are queued in the FIFO Pipeline
- **Free Hours & Schedule Advisor (`/schedule`):** Shows 24h IST load, free hours, best slots & 1-click Auto-Stagger

## 🚨 LANE 2: Smart Error Handler, Gemini Doctor & Circuit Breaker
- Auto-pauses the broken scheduled workflow so it doesn't loop
- Auto-discovers & pauses downstream dependent workflows (shared Google Sheets, Supabase tables, or sub-workflows)
- Diagnoses root cause & fix steps via free **Google Gemini Flash** (0% Hostinger KVM2 CPU load)

## 💾 LANE 3: Daily 00:00 IST Commercial-Grade Sanitized GitHub Backup
- Scrubs all PII, API Keys, Credential IDs, Google Sheet/Doc IDs, Chat IDs, Webhook UUIDs & private domains
- Makes every exported JSON ready to ship or sell on n8n Marketplace
- Only commits to `YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/n8n-workflows/workflows/YYYY/MM/` when a workflow actually changes

## 🚦 LANE 4: 1-Minute Concurrency Watchdog & FIFO Pipeline Runner
- Detects when a scheduled workflow overlaps with an already-running workflow
- Stops the newer overlapping run before it crashes the server, puts it in the Pipeline Queue, and auto-runs it as soon as the active workflow finishes!

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 30, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how n8n Automation Suite ("we", "our", or "the Application") accesses, uses, and stores Google user data when authorized by the account owner.

1. Data Accessed

With explicit OAuth 2.0 consent, this personal automation application accesses Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gmail solely within the authenticated user's own account to generate job application documents, resumes, cover letters, and workflow notifications.

2. Data Usage & Storage

All data processed by the Application remains strictly within the user's self-hosted n8n instance and personal Google Workspace/Google Account. No user data is sold, shared with third parties, or used for advertising.

3. Revoking Access

You may revoke OAuth access at any time via your Google Account Permissions page.

4. Contact

For questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact the administrator of this domain.
